Spending policies & approvals+

Application rules run in this demo’s Rust bridge before signing/execution. These are public, local demonstration controls, not audited production authorization. A policy change invalidates pending approvals and signatures.

What’s powered by the SDK?+

NUNCHI SDK

Actual asset movement.

Coins: SDK genesis creates the asset and five account allocations. Signed CoinOperation::Transfer transactions run through Ledger::apply_transaction. SDK balance and nonce queries supply the readback.

Crypto + Common: public demo identities, encoding, signing and signature verification.

Oracle: signs, appends and reads a service-context record referencing the payment’s genuine SDK transaction ID.

THE APPLICATION

Requests and commerce policies.

Agent behavior, marketplace quotes, spending allocations, approved providers, approval thresholds, pauses, idempotency, service responses and the interface are application logic.

RPC, Chain, Mempool and Access Control are not used. The inspected Access Control module provides scope/role primitives; this example does not use it to enforce commerce policies.

WHY IT MATTERS

A payment you can follow.

Developers can compose financial and cryptographic primitives with their own service and authorization systems.

This is an in-process SDK ledger, not a complete agent wallet, merchant network, production payment gateway or audited payment service.

Simulation Assumptions & SDK Details+

Asset and accounts

SDK 2026.9.0-alpha.1, commit eea35ced709f68c15d6fbc8bcc754696a7e44374. Original Coins source is vendored unchanged and hash checked, alongside shared Crypto/Common/Oracle sources.

DCR is a disposable, two-decimal demo asset. Genesis supplies 50,000 minor units: 100 credits to each of five agents, zero to five providers. Each session derives a different asset ID. Keys are public deterministic test identities.

Execution and controls

The bridge explicitly verifies signatures before applying a Coins transaction to a cloned memory ledger. Only successful application plus matching sender/recipient readback becomes an applied payment. Failed staged state is discarded.

Application idempotency reuses an applied result by request ID. The independent SDK nonce replay test submits the original signed bytes to a disposable clone and reports the actual SDK rejection. Both are distinct.

Service fulfillment writes a related Oracle record after payment. A receipt failure leaves the payment applied and can be retried without paying again.

Limits and provenance

All services and responses are fictional. No real assets, external merchants, public-network finality, persistent QMDB, state-root proof or RPC backend are deployed. Refresh/restart clears local state.

CoinDB and OracleDB run over an app-provided memory StateStore. Browser Cargo manifests and small Common adapters disable native storage. No authenticated root or commit is claimed.

128 requests maximum. No fees configured. Context sequence/timestamps are application supplied. Export replay verifies included local evidence, not snapshot completeness or a real service outcome.

Build with Nunchi+

Excerpts below come from this demo’s actual Rust implementation. PaymentsSdk and PaymentNetwork are application wrappers, not native SDK APIs.

Create the demo asset and allocations / SDK genesis

 fn new(id:&str)->Result<Self,String>{
  if id.len()<8||id.len()>80||!id.bytes().all(|c|c.is_ascii_alphanumeric()||b"-_".contains(&c)){return Err("Invalid session ID.".into());}
  let spec=CoinSpec::new(TokenSymbol::new("DCR").unwrap(),TokenName::new(format!("Isolated demo credits {id}")).unwrap(),2,SUPPLY as u128,Some(SUPPLY as u128));
  let coin=TokenFactory::derive_coin_id(&address(10),0,&spec);
  let mut coins=Ledger::new(Memory::default());
  block_on(coins.apply_genesis(&CoinsGenesis{account_policies:vec![],tokens:vec![TokenGenesis{issuer:address(10),spec,allocations:(0..5).map(|i|AllocationGenesis{account:address(i),amount:10000}).collect()}],fees:None})).map_err(|e|e.to_string())?;
  if block_on(coins.token(&coin)).map_err(|e|e.to_string())?.is_none(){return Err("SDK genesis token readback failed.".into());}
  Ok(Self{id:id.into(),coin,coins,oracle:OracleLedger::new(Memory::default()),namespace:NamespaceId(Sha256::hash(&[b"agent-payment-network/",id.as_bytes()])),policies:(0..5).map(|i|Policy{allocation_minor:10000,maximum_minor:2000,approval_above_minor:1500,allowed_providers:if i==2{vec![2]}else{vec![i,2]},paused:false,version:1}).collect(),prices:vec![1500,500,200,300,1200],requests:vec![],timeline:vec![],oracle_records:vec![],duplicates:0})
 }

Sign, apply and read back the transfer / SDK Coins

 fn sign(&mut self,n:usize)->Result<(),String>{if self.requests[n]["status"]!="approved"{return Err("The request is not approved.".into());}if let Some(e)=self.policy_error(n){return Err(e);}let a=self.requests[n]["agent_index"].as_u64().unwrap() as usize;let p=self.requests[n]["provider_index"].as_u64().unwrap() as usize;let amount=self.requests[n]["amount_minor"].as_u64().unwrap();let nonce=block_on(self.coins.nonce(&address(a))).map_err(|e|e.to_string())?;
 let tx=Transaction::sign(&key(a),nonce,CoinOperation::Transfer{coin:self.coin,from:address(a),to:address(p+5),amount:amount as u128});tx.verify().map_err(|e|e.to_string())?;
 self.requests[n]["transaction"]=Self::signed_json(&tx)?;self.requests[n]["status"]=json!("signed");self.log(n,"signed","sdk","Coins transaction signed and verified by original SDK cryptography.");Ok(())}
 fn duplicate(&mut self,n:usize){self.duplicates+=1;self.log(n,"duplicate_prevented","application","Stable request ID already has an applied payment. Reused original result; no second transfer submitted.");}
 fn apply(&mut self,n:usize)->Result<(),String>{
 if self.requests[n].get("payment").is_some(){self.duplicate(n);return Ok(());}if self.requests[n]["status"]!="submitted"{return Err("Submit the signed request before applying it.".into());}if let Some(reason)=self.policy_error(n){self.requests[n]["status"]=json!("rejected");self.requests[n]["rejection_reason"]=json!(reason.clone());self.log(n,"rejected","application",&format!("{reason} No ledger operation applied."));return Ok(());}
 let tx=transaction(self.requests[n]["transaction"]["signed_transaction"].as_str().unwrap())?;tx.verify().map_err(|e|e.to_string())?;let a=self.requests[n]["agent_index"].as_u64().unwrap() as usize;let p=self.requests[n]["provider_index"].as_u64().unwrap() as usize;let amount=self.requests[n]["amount_minor"].as_u64().unwrap();
 let before=self.balances()?;let mut next=self.coins.clone();let mut events=VecEventSink::new();
 match block_on(next.apply_transaction(&tx,&mut events)){Err(e)=>{self.requests[n]["status"]=json!("failed");self.requests[n]["execution_error"]=json!(e.to_string());self.log(n,"failed","sdk",&format!("SDK Coins rejected execution: {e}. Staged state discarded."));return Ok(())},Ok(())=>{}}
 let sender=block_on(next.balance(&address(a),&self.coin)).map_err(|e|e.to_string())?;let recipient=block_on(next.balance(&address(p+5),&self.coin)).map_err(|e|e.to_string())?;
 if sender+amount as u128!=before[a]["balance_minor"].as_str().unwrap().parse::<u128>().unwrap()||recipient!=before[p+5]["balance_minor"].as_str().unwrap().parse::<u128>().unwrap()+amount as u128{return Err("SDK balance readback did not match the transfer.".into());}
 self.coins=next;let after=self.balances()?;self.requests[n]["payment"]=json!({"execution":"applied_to_local_sdk_ledger","balance_readback_matches":true,"before":before,"after":after,"sdk_events":events.events().iter().map(|e|json!({"name":String::from_utf8_lossy(&e.name),"payload_hex":hex::encode(&e.value)})).collect::<Vec<_>>()});self.requests[n]["status"]=json!("applied");self.log(n,"applied","sdk","Original Coins ledger applied the signed transfer. Sender and recipient balances were read back.");Ok(())}

Associate the payment with its service / SDK Oracle

 fn fulfill(&mut self,n:usize)->Result<(),String>{if self.requests[n]["status"]=="fulfilled"{return Ok(());}if self.requests[n]["status"]!="applied"{return Err("The service cannot fulfill an unpaid request.".into());}
 let a=self.requests[n]["agent_index"].as_u64().unwrap() as usize;let payload=json!({"session_id":self.id,"request_id":self.requests[n]["request_id"],"task_id":self.requests[n]["task_id"],"agent_index":a,"provider_index":self.requests[n]["provider_index"],"amount_minor":self.requests[n]["amount_minor"],"transaction_id":self.requests[n]["transaction"]["transaction_id"],"authorization":"Application policy approved","manual_approved":self.requests[n]["manual_approved"],"policy_version":self.requests[n]["policy_version"],"fulfillment":"Simulated service response; no external merchant contacted"});
 let nonce=self.oracle_records.iter().filter(|r|r["payload"]["agent_index"]==a).count() as u64;let bucket=IntervalKey::new(0);let tx=OracleTransaction::sign(&key(a),nonce,OracleOperation::AppendRecord{namespace:self.namespace,interval:bucket,payload:serde_json::to_vec(&payload).unwrap(),proof:None});tx.verify().map_err(|e|e.to_string())?;
 let mut next=self.oracle.clone();block_on(next.apply_transaction(&tx,RuntimeContext{height:self.oracle_records.len() as u64+1,timestamp_ms:(n as u64+1)*1000,..Default::default()})).map_err(|e|e.to_string())?;let records=block_on(next.records_by_namespace(&self.namespace,bucket,bucket)).map_err(|e|e.to_string())?;let record=records.last().ok_or("Oracle returned no service record.")?;let stored=block_on(next.record(&record.id)).map_err(|e|e.to_string())?.ok_or("Oracle service record readback failed.")?;let OracleOperation::AppendRecord{payload:original,..}=&tx.payload.operation;if stored.payload!=*original{return Err("Oracle payload readback differs.".into());}
 let evidence=json!({"record_id":enc(&stored.id),"namespace":enc(&stored.namespace),"writer":enc(&stored.writer),"payload":payload,"payload_hex":hex::encode(&stored.payload),"signed_transaction":enc(&tx),"transaction_id":enc(&tx.digest()),"signature_valid":tx.verify().is_ok(),"readback_matches":true});
 self.oracle=next;self.oracle_records.push(evidence.clone());self.requests[n]["service_record"]=evidence;self.requests[n]["status"]=json!("fulfilled");self.log(n,"fulfilled","application + SDK","Simulated service delivered; related signed Oracle record written and read back.");Ok(())}
